task.title: Define Pi Code foundation runtime contracts
task.summary: Model Pi Code as CodeWiki's primary runtime foundation while defining explicit capability contracts for model/runtime plug points and future compatible execution backends.

goal.outcome: Pi Code foundation and optional runtime/model support contracts are explicit in code and docs.
acceptance: Runtime capability contracts document who owns model loop, session/thread state, tools, context assembly, compaction, and event streams.
Pi Code is represented as the first-class foundation path, not only a generic adapter.
Unsupported runtimes fail closed or report platform-limited capability evidence.
Tests cover capability discovery/unsupported capability behavior.
non_goals: Do not implement a non-Pi runtime backend.
Do not change model provider configuration beyond contract shape.
Do not implement daemon job storage.
verification: search/docs confirm Pi foundation wording and support-contract boundaries.

delta.desired: CodeWiki can grow pluggable runtime/model policy without losing Pi Code foundation semantics.
delta.current: Runtime ports exist but do not encode the approved Pi foundation plus future capability contract model.
delta.closure: Close when contracts and tests are in place.
